parameters.content:
## WF03 Responsibility
Validates the WF02 handoff, loads canonical state, enriches missing business data, calculates deterministic qualification, obtains an independent Gemini assessment, resolves conflicts, persists decisions, and hands the canonical lead to WF04. It does not perform intake, identity resolution, sales assignment, CRM sync, messaging, or follow-up.

## Enrichment Behavior
Enrichment is requested only when company size, industry, or country is missing. Existing reliable values win over enrichment. The HTTP call uses finite retry: three total attempts with backoff, enabling the required timeout/timeout/success demonstration. Exhaustion becomes a technical failure and Manual Review; values are never fabricated. Configure MOCK_ENRICHMENT_URL.

## Deterministic Scoring
The rule engine implements the documented company-size, service-value, intent, urgency, geography, strategic-account, and data-quality rules. The final deterministic score is clamped to 0–100.
Assessment/demo business configuration is centralized in the scoring Code node. AI Automation and Enterprise Automation are treated as high-value services; CRM Automation and Workflow Automation are treated as medium-value services.
Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and UAE are configured as target markets, including supported country-name and country-code variants. Leads from a configured target market receive the documented geography contribution.
These mappings are explicit assessment/demo configuration and can be replaced with approved production business configuration without changing the scoring logic.
Gemini remains independent from deterministic scoring and never supplies or modifies numerical-score inputs..

## AI Independence and Conflict Resolution
AI does not modify the deterministic score. Material disagreement triggers Manual Review. Technical AI failure is not equivalent to Low Potential.

The full business-rules matrix preserves deterministic VIP/Qualified/Nurture/Unqualified outcomes for agreement or neutral medium/unknown signals. VIP/Qualified + low_potential and Nurture/Unqualified + high_potential route to Manual Review. Malformed, empty, unavailable, or exhausted AI calls are technical failures.

## WF04 Handoff
WF03 preserves the complete canonical lead and hands the final qualification outcome to WF04_routing_crm. WF04 owns Post-Qualification Routing, sales assignment, CRM behavior, and downstream orchestration. The name-based reference may require selecting and publishing WF04 after import; WF04 business logic is not implemented here.

parameters.query:
SELECT l.*, $2::jsonb AS workflow_lead
FROM leads l
WHERE l.id = $1::uuid
LIMIT 1;
